purpose: Post-hoc detector-weighted diagnostic for all five frozen SXS cases after their initial residuals were observed. Reuse the selected-case mass sweep, PSD, settled-frequency cutoff, and complex dominant-mode convention. This is neither an independent holdout nor release qualification.
lower_cutoff: max(10 Hz, 2*NR reference orbital M Omega/(2*pi*M_seconds)); highest-resolution metadata reference_time equals relaxation_time
psd: Pinned public lalsimulation SimNoisePSDaLIGOZeroDetHighPower; validation-only dependency
analytic_mode_convention: FFT of conjugated h_22; compare positive-frequency bins; optimize one global time and phase shift without amplitude or intrinsic-parameter fit.
interpretation: A sampled overlap below 0.99 is evidence against release at that row under this proxy. A sampled overlap above 0.99 cannot establish full-domain physical faithfulness, the peak-time gate, or ROM fidelity.
